claims.statement: EU law distinguishes by-products from waste only when further use is certain, direct under normal practice, integral to production, lawful, and environmentally safe.
Poland's BDO lets businesses check the declared scope and legality of prospective waste counterparties and records waste transfers electronically.
Demand hypothesis: manufacturers will share savings when a documented repeat offtake replaces a disposal route.

contrary_evidence: By-product and end-of-waste status is fact-specific; a generic marketplace screen cannot establish it.
Transport and testing can erase the value of low-density material.

economics.acquisition_route: Demand hypothesis: one industrial park and one waste adviser can surface 20 recurring streams for triage
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 300 active streams averaging 1500 PLN monthly platform revenue yields 5.4m PLN ARR; 25% EBITDA at a 4x value could exceed 5m PLN in 5-7 years
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly, with classification and laboratory judgments delegated to qualified partners
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 60-75% after subcontracted legal and lab work, improving as stream templates repeat
economics.payback: Economics hypothesis: 10 packets at 8000 PLN average cover setup capital within 9-15 months before transaction fees
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 5000-15000 PLN per stream packet plus 5-10% of documented disposal savings or transaction margin
economics.retention_or_repeat: Monthly lots, updated tests, receiver verification, and renewal of forward offtakes create repeat revenue

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Accepted material specifications, regulator-tested reasoning patterns, receiver permits, and performance history by stream
fingerprint.customer: Food, wood, metal, mineral, and chemical SMEs producing consistent side streams and plants buying secondary inputs
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Waste advisers, labs, industrial parks, chambers of commerce, and direct cluster-by-cluster acquisition
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Evidence workspace, material specification, BDO counterparty checks, test coordination, forward lots, and compliant transfer workflow
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Generator pays for the clearance packet and a success fee when a qualified receiver contracts an offtake
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A recurring residue has a plausible user but neither party can confidently classify, specify, document, or reserve it

founder_fit: Data normalization and matching suit the founder
Can start locally with bounded expert partners

structure.control_point: The versioned material-status and buyer-eligibility packet attached to repeat forward supply
structure.critical_dependency: Qualified advisers must validate classification; the platform cannot self-declare a material lawful or safe

thesis: Recurring manufacturers publish owner-authorized side streams only after a structured by-product, end-of-waste, or waste-routing packet is assembled with qualified legal and testing partners. Demand hypothesis: certainty of lawful use plus repeat volume can convert disposal cost into contracted input supply.
title: Industrial By-Product Clearance and Offtake Exchange
